starship.notes: Reviewed 1.26.0 to 1.27.0. Installed 1.27.0 includes security fixes for untrusted Git execution and unbounded reads. Directory symlink rendering and SSH hostname detection fixes need no tracked configuration changes. New Jujutsu modules and Bash right-prompt support are optional; the tracked prompt uses Git and Fish. Older baseline coverage remains 1.26.0 only.

ghostty.notes: Reviewed 1.3.1 to 1.4.0. Installed 1.3.1 remains behind; recommend upgrading for terminal-output, paste and macOS link-handling security fixes. Existing ssh-env and ssh-terminfo settings now use ghostty +ssh and preserve SSH SetEnv. No required tracked configuration change identified. New macOS selection and Cmd-arrow defaults and GTK Ctrl-Shift-arrow bindings need user runtime review. The tracked config does not set deprecated copy-on-select or scrollback-limit keys. GTK now requires GTK 4.18, libadwaita 1.7 and working EGL; fractional scaling and memory behavior improve. Linux upgrade, shader/rendering checks, SSH checks and macOS validation remain outstanding. November 19: Installed 1.4.0; upgrade is complete and ghostty +validate-config passes. No newer stable release is listed. Shader/SSH interaction and macOS behavior remain untested.

zellij.notes: November 19: Reviewed 0.45.1 through 0.46.0; installed 0.46.0. Resurrection serialization, startup races, rendering and throughput fixes apply to the existing multiplexer. Plugin SDK source APIs changed; no plugin source is maintained here. Keep the choose-tree binary pin pending interactive validation. The tracked configuration validates and the real isolated zmux failed-session recovery test passes. The first integration run was blocked by sandbox socket permissions; the permitted isolated retry passed. Keep the recovery wrapper. The new desktop terminal, inbox and mouse controls are optional; no defaults or bindings were changed. November 26: Reviewed 0.46.0 through 0.46.1; installed 0.46.1. Patch release fixes resurrected sessions without input being deleted on switch, stdin_pump EOF spin, zellij action after rename, fullscreen stack orientation and plugin manager listing, and adds zellij events and show_setup_screen. No required config change; zellij setup --check and the real isolated zmux integration suite pass (10/10). Keep the zmux recovery wrapper and choose-tree pin.

tmux.notes: Initial baseline: 3.7 through 3.7c and the 3.7 release notes. No required config changes; copy-mode line numbers are optional. Older releases not reviewed. Reviewed 3.7c to 3.8: new theme defaults, floating panes, event hooks and copy-mode behavior. No required migration found in tracked bindings. Retain explicit mouse on for older hosts. Installed 3.7c; 3.8 runtime behavior remains untested. The previous report incorrectly excluded 3.8 as a release candidate; current upstream lists it as stable. October 28: installed 3.8; the package upgrade is complete, but runtime keybinding and copy-mode behavior were not tested in this pass.

helix.notes: Initial baseline: 25.07.1 release notes plus 25.07 upgrade notes. Tracked keymaps do not use changed command-mode syntax. Markdown and extracted HTML/CSS/JSON servers are installed and found by health checks. Selected JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Fish, Bash, Lua, TOML and YAML servers are declared and found by post-apply Helix health checks. These checks confirm executable discovery, not project-level LSP operation. User prefers one server per configured language, selecting the first Helix default: ty for Python, taplo for TOML, yaml-language-server for YAML and vscode-html-language-server for HTML. Markdown intentionally retains marksman, markdown-oxide and harper-ls. Extra Python, TOML and Ansible package declarations were removed. User otherwise prefers Helix defaults; Kotlin default is deprecated upstream and its AUR package requires Java 11. After user installed the rustup component, rust-analyzer --version succeeds (1.88.0). Rustfmt works; lldb-dap is absent. Older releases not reviewed.

hyprland.notes: Reviewed v0.56.2 to v0.57.0. Installed 0.57.0. Legacy configuration support is removed; tracked overrides already use Lua. New compositor session target is shipped by the package. Existing XDG-autostart drop-in remains useful: the vendor target does not pull in xdg-desktop-autostart.target. DMS service enablement and nofile override are retained. Stricter dispatcher validation and additional Lua APIs require no demonstrated change to tracked binds. No native replacement for monitor-dir.lua was established. Generated compositor config remains Dux-owned. Fresh-login, multi-monitor and rendering behavior remain untested. Reviewed v0.57.0 to v0.57.1. Installed remains 0.57.0. Backported fixes cover chord consumption, mouse inputs, removed outputs during session lock, NVIDIA black screens, rendering and Lua validation. Recommend upgrading; no required migration or replacement for the directional monitor helper appears in these notes. Existing Lua bindings and session integration remain unchanged; upgraded runtime behavior is untested. November 19: Reviewed v0.57.1 through v0.57.2; installed 0.57.2. Fixes include expired Lua window references, modifier resolution, rendering/fullscreen behavior and heavy-load crashes; realtime scheduling was disabled upstream. No required change to tracked Lua bindings or replacement for monitor-dir.lua was identified. Keep the monitor helper and XDG autostart integration. Fresh-login, lock/resume, rendering and multi-monitor behavior remain untested.

dux-shell.notes: Reviewed v1.6.3 to v2.0.0, including the rebrand announcement and directory/drop-in migration docs. Installed 2.0.0. Live XDG directories migrate to dms with legacy compatibility symlinks; binary and service names remain dms. Updated checkout paths, readiness checks, package declarations and documentation. Capture uses the migrated animation, bar-widget and dock schemas; dock display selectors and compositor migration markers stay local. Ignored checkout overrides migrate without overwriting conflicts. Existing KDE Connect device selection moved to a local plugin overlay. Adopted native config.d: writable 10-dotfiles.json and 90-dotfiles.local.json, with top-level native precedence. GUI edits stay in live files until explicit filtered capture. Other drop-ins remain local and unchanged. Apply removes duplicate managed base keys so deleted shared settings cannot revive stale values; unowned base keys remain. Clipboard settings and plugin preferences retain the auxiliary replacement contract. First native migration is foreground-only; background apply logs a retryable failure until the managed drop-in exists. One DMS restart is required after creating config.d; November 7: both managed native drop-ins are present and capture is unchanged; the one-time restart was not independently verified. Verified unchanged effective settings and idempotence using a temporary copy of live configuration, and verified native precedence/write routing against the exact upstream JavaScript functions. Plugin revisions remain unchanged; deprecated QML wrappers remain available, but interactive plugin behavior is untested. Keep the existing nofile override: vendor soft limit is still 16384. The previously deferred repository migration is resolved by the 2.1 guidance: Arch has no repositories to migrate; AUR replacements remain manual. Companion declarations now use dux-calendar-bin, dux-search-bin and the user-selected stable dux-greeter-bin; those replacements are not installed yet. Lock/suspend/resume and fresh-login checks remain outstanding. Dux Files and other new UI features are optional and were not enabled. Reviewed v2.0.0 through v2.1.0 and v2.1.1, including upgrade notes. Installed shell remains 2.0.0. Recommend upgrading for settings persistence, concurrent-session clipboard preservation, lock/suspend, Hyprland screenshot and tray fixes. Existing Lua overrides satisfy the removal of legacy conf support. Dux Search HTTP is now opt-in; no tracked HTTP client was found. The 2.1.1 service orders itself before tray.target but retains the 16384 soft nofile limit, so keep the existing limit override and XDG autostart integration. No required tracked configuration change or replacement for monitor-dir.lua was identified. Keep plugin pins unchanged; new versions and interactive behavior are untested. Interface density and Classic styling are optional GUI choices, not enabled by this pass. The user retained the three dux companion declarations and cleared their six inverse package entries; live replacements remain outstanding. November 19: Reviewed v2.1.1 through v2.1.2; installed 2.1.2. Companion migration is now complete: dux-calendar-bin 2.1.2, dux-search-bin 2.1.1 and dux-greeter-bin 2.1.2 are installed. Notes cover horizontal scroll, system-monitor input/icons, island layout, launcher matching and QML stack fixes. Media scroll now defaults to no action. No required integration change was identified; retain the nofile override (vendor soft limit remains 16384), XDG autostart integration and plugin pins. Plugin and auxiliary settings capture is unchanged. Main settings capture contains legacy top-level animation, widget color, workspace and logo keys, plus removal of cursorSettings; upstream still supports cursorSettings. November 20 capture decision: retain the shared Brood War cursor at size 32 and discard all twelve legacy top-level additions. The shared settings patch matches its pre-capture contents; no live settings were applied. Desktop runtime checks remain outstanding. November 22: Shared settings, auxiliary settings and plugin capture are unchanged. On the current machine, all three declared dux companion packages are absent and dankcalendar-bin 1.6.1 remains installed. Prior companion migration evidence does not establish migration on this machine. User retained all three shared companion declarations and cleared their inverse entries; installation on this machine remains outstanding. Capture succeeded after permission for the DMS-owned live plugin lockfile write. No live settings were applied. November 26: Shared settings, auxiliary settings and plugin capture are unchanged. On olaf-x1c, dux-calendar-bin 2.1.2, dux-search-bin 2.1.1 and dux-greeter-bin 2.1.2 are now installed and dankcalendar-bin is absent, completing companion migration on this host. Vendor dms.service still sets LimitNOFILE=16384:infinity; keep the nofile override. No live settings were applied.

rclone.notes: Initial baseline: v1.75.1 patch notes only. Bisync empty-file accounting, crypt directory names and VFS fixes are relevant; no required wrapper or mount changes identified. Older releases not reviewed. Reviewed v1.75.1 to v1.75.2: security fixes and VFS cached-read, modtime and shutdown fixes. Recommend upgrade, especially for the full-cache Drive mount. No required mount-unit or bisync wrapper changes identified. Installed 1.75.1; upgraded runtime behavior remains untested. October 28: installed 1.75.2; the upgrade is complete, but mount/bisync runtime validation was not performed in this pass. Reviewed v1.75.2 to v1.76.0. Installed remains 1.75.2. Recommend upgrading for local symlink boundary and redirect security fixes, bisync conflict/listing correctness, VFS rename/truncate fixes and uploads delayed by continued reads. Environment-defined remotes no longer write configuration back to disk, relevant to private-sync. No required flag or configuration changes identified for the full-cache Drive mount or encrypted bisync wrapper. HTTPS downgrades now fail by default; retain that default. OneDrive Business/SharePoint requires 1.76+ before April 1, 2027, but no such backend is declared by these wrappers. New-version local regression checks and live mount/bisync validation remain pending. November 19: Installed 1.76.0; upgrade is complete. The installed mount unit matches shared intent, including the 50 GiB cache. Local encrypted-sync, conflict-preservation and secret-materialization regression tests pass against temporary files with no cloud or vault access. Live mount/bisync validation remains outstanding.

bitwarden-cli.notes: Initial baseline: CLI v2026.2.0; older releases not reviewed. Reviewed subsequent published releases 2026.3.0, 2026.4.1, 2026.4.2, 2026.5.0, 2026.6.0, 2026.7.0, 2026.8.0, 2026.9.0 and 2026.9.1. Recommend upgrading for API-key local-storage and other security fixes. Login password-reset flows were removed; SDK login/unlock/sync handling changed. The get-item visibility fix redacts protected values when viewPassword is false; sync helpers require access to the stored secrets and already reject missing values. No required command-syntax change identified. Upgrade and live-vault validation of unlock, sync, get item and lock remain follow-up work; no live vault was accessed. Reviewed cli-v2026.9.1 to cli-v2026.10.0: SDK decryption changes, dependency security updates and flag-gated desktop biometric unlock. No required syntax change identified for the sync helpers. Installed CLI remains 2026.2.0. Upgrade and live-vault validation remain outstanding; biometric integration is optional and not implemented. Reviewed cli-v2026.10.0 to cli-v2026.10.1. Installed remains 2026.2.0. New notes cover importer and KDF safeguards, dependency security fixes, export corrections, biometric IPC and SDK decryption changes. No required syntax change identified for unlock --raw, sync, get item or lock. Upgrade remains recommended; new-version regression checks and live-vault validation are still outstanding. No vault was accessed. November 19: Reviewed cli-v2026.10.1 through cli-v2026.11.0. New shared-folder commands, storage locking/read/write and command-exit fixes, SDK readiness and decryption changes. Commercial direct-download ZIP names now use bw-bit-*; no direct ZIP downloader is maintained here. Existing unlock --raw, sync, get item and lock syntax needs no demonstrated change. Installed package and local Arch sync database both remain 2026.2.0-1 after the user update. Recommend a separately reviewed packaging/source decision to obtain a current CLI. The live version command failed because the sandbox denied its data.json.lock write; package metadata was used. No vault unlock, sync or item retrieval was performed. Live-vault checks remain outstanding. November 22: Installed package and local Arch sync database remain 2026.2.0-1. Current upstream CLI remains 2026.11.0; the packaging decision and live-vault validation remain outstanding. November 26: Reviewed cli-v2026.11.0 through cli-v2026.11.1. Release adds Secrets Manager (bw sm) CLI commands and validation/export fixes; no change to unlock --raw, sync, get item or lock. Installed package and local Arch sync database remain 2026.2.0-1; packaging decision and live-vault validation remain outstanding.
